findings.countingRule: Exclude Saturdays, Sundays, holidays and days neither House is in session because of sine-die adjournment, recess over three days, or adjournment over three days; count from transmission under applicable subsection, later specified effective date controls.
findings.scope: These are statutory counted-day windows, not 30/60 elapsed civil days. Criminal joint-disapproval transmission proviso remains material.

interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
